static_traits.name: Luo Qian
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty connecting with new teammates, feeling like not belonging to the team; family is supportive but does not fully understand the pressure of being an Athlete
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before; the problem appeared after joining the new team a month ago
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, highly cooperative, slightly nervous and able to engage in self-Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: Since joining the new team, always sitting on the bench, feeling very useless, this Self-denial has affected motivation in training and games, on-field performance, and overall mental health.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to find ways to overcome the feeling of 'incapable/useless', because these feelings are affecting their on-field performance and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: In the previous team, showed confidence, was often praised by the former coach for skill and effort, and was once regarded as an outstanding player on the team; this positive experience constitutes an early source of self-efficacy and a sense of capability.

After joining the new team a month ago, the new environment and performance pressure triggered strong Self-doubt; feeling judged in training and games, spending more time on the bench, trying to communicate with coaches and teammates, seeking feedback and advice, but not yet able to ease the sense of powerlessness and not belonging.
Overall family support, can confide, but family has limited understanding of the professional pressure of being an Athlete, support stays more at the emotional level than professional guidance.

core_beliefs: I do not belong to this team
I am not worthy of the coach's attention

special_situations.event: Sits on the bench for a long time during team training or matches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot play, it means I have no value, my ability is insufficient
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks feedback and advice from coaches and teammates, and tries to perform harder in training
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am utterly useless, the coach will never value me

special_situations.event: Feeling judged by others in training or competitions with the new team
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others think I am not good enough, it proves I do not belong here
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On the field, nervous and hesitant, reduces risks and attempts to avoid mistakes being seen
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They look down on me, thinking I am not good enough

special_situations.event: After joining the new team, facing higher expectations and pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot prove myself soon, I will keep being ignored, having no chance to play
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Willingness to participate in training and competitions decreases, producing avoidance and procrastination
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be able to prove myself, the coach will not see my value

special_situations.event: At night before falling asleep, repeatedly thinks about the day's training and match
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not ruminate over every mistake, I will keep failing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overthinks, ignores positive episodes, sacrifices sleep in hopes of improving
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I did terribly today; I must correct all the problems

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a valuable team member, gain playing opportunities, and feel belonging
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged as incapable, Being rejected or marginalized
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety by reducing exposure and avoiding evaluation
Using self-criticism to preemptively defuse the blow of outside negation

object_relations.object_representation: An old coach who supported and affirmed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about experiences of 'being judged' or when others' feedback cannot immediately ease their Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' neutral or constructive feedback as negative judgment and negation (transference: seeing the outside world as fault-finders)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle Clarification and Empathy tone, acknowledge their feelings, distinguish facts from Interpretation, avoid judgmental language, invite specific evidence and present-moment experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing 'showing oneself' or being asked to be more proactive in training/competitions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If unable to perform perfectly, will be Being rejected, so turning frustration into self-criticism and self-blame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use supportive and specific Questioning, reduce the tone of self-reproach, emphasize process and incremental goals, encourage identifying small controllable steps.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When placed on the bench or discussing playing eligibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views self and others in binary terms of 'substitute = failure, playing = success'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses a gentle contrast-and-integration strategy, points out shades of gray and multidimensional performance, invites them to see both strengths and areas needing improvement at once, and avoids absolutist words.

manifestations: Feeling of not belonging in the new team, difficulty connecting with teammates
Views others as judges; reduces open contact
outcomes: Decreased drive in training and games

manifestations: Self-labeling as 'useless', questioning one's own value
Equating being a substitute with failure, hard to experience achievement and meaning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats 'must prove oneself immediately in a new environment' as a rigid standard
Measures self-worth mainly by others' expectations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Tense on the field, hesitating, second-guessing
Overly concerned with others' judgments; repeatedly criticizes oneself
Reduces proactive contact for fear of negative evaluation

positive_force: Having real competitive skill and success experience (frequently praised by the old coach)
Actively seeks feedback and professional help (communicates with coach and teammates, enters counseling)
Family emotional support available to confide in
Willing to try behavioral experiments and keep an open mind
negative_force: Overly concerned with others' judgment; mind-reading tendency
Disrupted sleep and Decreased drive forming a vicious cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased drive in avoiding or reducing participation in training and games
antecedent: Facing high expectations and pressure after joining a new team
Being assigned as a substitute in training or competitions
Feeling judged by the coach and teammates
target_behavior.core_reason: Making a black-and-white Interpretation of 'not playing = failure', predicting being negated and thus avoiding to reduce Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and the sense of failure, temporarily maintaining psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: Training and Performance declining further, difficulty getting playing chances, Reinforcement of the feeling of 'not belonging to the team'

target_behavior.behavior: Tense on the field, hesitant, repeatedly Self-doubting and second-guessing
antecedent: Teammates or coaches suggest being 'more confident'
Subjectively feeling that others are judging oneself
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly dependent on external validation, with excessive worry about mistakes and mind-reading tendencies
target_behavior.function: Reduces the possibility of being criticized by cutting back on risk-taking and trying
target_behavior.consequence: Sluggish movements, worse performance, forming a vicious cycle of Anxiety—mistakes—self-blame

antecedent: Replaying training and match performance at night
Focuses on negative details, ignoring the positive parts
target_behavior.core_reason: Trying to control failure and Anxiety through rumination, with mental filtering and the rigid rule of 'must fix all problems'
target_behavior.function: Temporarily relieving uncertainty through cognitive overcontrol
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient sleep, poor Recovery, further decline in next-day training and game condition

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating speech (such as 'I am utterly useless')
antecedent: After sitting on the bench or making a mistake
Encountering new-environment pressure and a sense of not belonging
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized negative core beliefs and a personalization interpretation pattern
target_behavior.function: Preemptively buffering the potential blow of outside negation through Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem and Decreased drive, Interpersonal alienation, further affecting athletic performance and team integration
